name: c12g-check
description: Step C12g books check: 420 s at MAX (seed 5), the whole dish lit, mineral, vent, soap, linker and ion springs, N (60 s), 40 cells placed with the add-cell tool (80 s), a wash (100 s), a resize (150 s), G (200 s), a resize back (220 s), every C12g switch and knob off and on at runtime (250 to 350 s), membranes and lipids off and on, a snapshot saved and loaded at once (380 s); atoms and charge rounding must stay 0

evals.js: const v = moire.control.view(); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.3, v.cssH * 0.35, 'soap', 120); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.5, v.cssH * 0.5, 'linker', 120); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.6, v.cssH * 0.3, 'ions', 120); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.4, v.cssH * 0.6, 'light', 1e9); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.6, v.cssH * 0.6, 'heavy', 1e9); return moire.matter.springs.length
return await moire.app.place(Array.from({length: 40}, (_, k) => [150 + 13 * k, 120]), moire.genome.founders[0])

const v = moire.control.view(); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.4, v.cssH * 0.4, 'light', 1e9); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.6, v.cssH * 0.6, 'heavy', 200); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.6, v.cssH * 0.4, 'ions', 200); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.4, v.cssH * 0.6, 'soap', 200); return 1
moire.ions.params.block = true; moire.ions.params.genes = false; return 'block on, channel genes off'
moire.ions.params.genes = true; moire.ions.params.volt = true; moire.ions.params.kV = 20; return 'voltage push on, strong'
moire.ions.params.ionPass = 0; moire.ions.params.chanBase = 0.01; moire.pumps.params.vCap = 0.01; return 'ions nearly shut, small capacitance'
moire.ions.params.ionPass = 0.05; moire.ions.params.chanBase = 0.2; moire.ions.params.kV = 4; moire.ions.params.volt = false; moire.pumps.params.vCap = 0.1; return 'knobs back'
moire.membrane.params.on = true; moire.lipids.params.on = false; return 'lipids off (C6c weave blocks by integrity)'
moire.lipids.params.on = true; moire.membrane.params.select = false; return 'all on, selectivity gene off'
const S = await moire.snapshot({ grid: true }); const r = await moire.loadSnapshot(S); return { exact: r.exact, notes: r.notes, rounding: r.rounding }
